source_name: NASA Technical Reports Server (NTRS) / NASA STI Repository public collection
acceptance_note: The per-partition draft validation labels record the worker stage; supervisor-review.md accepts the complete set as the reusable translation specification subject to P-001 and the final preflight.

source_native_syntax.field_scope: default global NTRS q scope; no title/abstract restriction
source_native_syntax.pair_rule_representation: parenthesized same-record Boolean conjunction; no proximity claim
source_native_syntax.transport: UTF-8 application/json request body; q text is not URL percent-encoded

query_file_transport_rule.file_sha256_scope: all UTF-8 query-file bytes, including its one terminal LF
query_file_transport_rule.executed_q_text: decode UTF-8 and remove exactly the one terminal LF before assigning q in the JSON body; do not otherwise normalize, rewrap, encode, or rewrite the query

published.lte: replace only with the P-001 common evidence cutoff before final execution
published.mode: server-side payload filter, not appended to q

date_and_language_controls_for_future_fi.language: no native language restriction applied; determine report language during screening unless a later pilot validates a reliable source-side control
